item.name: House
item.cardSummary: A suburban home interior with tight rooms and patterned surfaces, the most forgiving starter map for learning how camouflage reads.
item.setting: Suburban home interior with furnished rooms, library props, and patterned walls
item.lighting: Warm and uneven, with softer pockets of light around furniture
item.bestHidingStrategy: Match the repeating room colors and break up your outline against furniture and wall patterns
item.difficulty: Beginner-friendly starter map; the busy surfaces and uneven light hide imperfect paint jobs more easily
item.seekerNote: Rooms read in a clear order, so sweep them one at a time instead of rushing
item.surfaceTexture: Furniture, library props, and patterned walls give plenty of texture to blend into
item.bestFor: Learning the basics of color matching and outline control
item.notes: Treated as the easiest of the four maps because its prop density and warm uneven lighting are forgiving to new hiders. Confirmed as one of the four launch maps across all sources.

item.name: Grocery Store
item.cardSummary: A retail supermarket of bright aisles and colorful shelf products, where the best hides borrow nearby product colors.
item.setting: Retail supermarket with stocked shelves, endcaps, and open aisles
item.lighting: Bright and flat across the aisles, with few shadowed pockets
item.bestHidingStrategy: Borrow the colors of nearby shelf products and endcaps so you read as part of the stock
item.difficulty: A clean, mid-range map; flat bright light is less forgiving than the House but the busy shelves still give cover
item.seekerNote: Sweep the aisles in order; the open layout rewards a steady, methodical search
item.surfaceTexture: Colorful shelf products and endcaps offer many color targets to match
item.bestFor: Practicing color matching against busy, varied backgrounds
item.notes: Bright flat lighting exposes mismatched paint more than the House, but the dense colorful shelving still supports good hides. Confirmed as one of the four launch maps.

item.name: Bank
item.cardSummary: A financial-institution interior of clean marble surfaces and long sightlines, the most punishing map for hiders.
item.setting: Financial institution interior with marble floors, clean walls, and open halls
item.lighting: Clean and cool, with even light that leaves few places to disappear
item.bestHidingStrategy: Control your outline and use side cover; smooth marble surfaces leave little texture to break up your shape
item.difficulty: The most punishing map for hiders; clean low-texture surfaces and long sightlines make a bad paint job easy to spot
item.seekerNote: Long sightlines reward seekers, so scan down the open halls before moving in
item.surfaceTexture: Marble floors and low-roughness surfaces give little visual noise to hide against
item.bestFor: Players who want the toughest hiding challenge and precise color work
item.notes: Described as the cleanest, least forgiving arena: long sightlines and smooth marble give hiders the fewest options. Confirmed as one of the four launch maps.

item.name: Arcade
item.cardSummary: A neon gaming hall of saturated colors and noisy visuals, the map with the highest skill ceiling for both sides.
item.setting: Neon gaming hall with arcade cabinets and saturated, busy decor
item.lighting: Bright and heavily saturated neon that shifts how every color reads
item.bestHidingStrategy: Manage both color and roughness against the neon so your paint matches the glow instead of standing out under it
item.difficulty: Highest skill ceiling; the saturated neon lighting can expose a bad paint job fast but rewards players who match it well
item.seekerNote: Bright saturated lighting can make a mismatched hider pop, so look for colors that fight the neon
item.surfaceTexture: Noisy neon surfaces and arcade cabinets create a busy, high-contrast backdrop
item.bestFor: Experienced players chasing the trickiest lighting on the roster
item.notes: Saturated neon makes color and roughness choices high-stakes: strong hides blend with the glow, weak ones stand out immediately. Confirmed as one of the four launch maps.
